unit.why: A single narrative: the Radoshitser and 'Maran' (the Magelnitser) ride together, apparently at random, to a village and there save Jewish merchants from non-Jews who wanted to accuse them falsely.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי איש אחד מעשה נפלאה
stories.summary_en: When the Radoshitser sees Maran (the Magelnitser) off, the two ride together without explanation to a village. There Jewish merchants are fleeing three non-Jews who want to accuse them falsely. The two tzaddikim sit in mock judgment, pay the non-Jews off with money and vodka, and so defuse the danger; the Radoshitser says the wonder was shared with the Magelnitser.
